messages:
elaine: Kicking off a small canary for sparq-v1 (sparse-aware 4-bit quant). Starting at 2% traffic vs prod baseline for 60m. Primary gates: conv-MRR drop <= 0.7%, hallucination delta <= 0.5pp, latency p95 <= +30ms. Auto-fallback enabled to baseline v2. Logs -> /canaries/sparq-v1. :eyes:

michael: ack. can we also track token-ppl delta and avg response length? those catch compression artifacts that MRR misses.

priya: for slice composition I suggest: 30% long-docs (>2k tokens), 20% code snippets, 40% chat/general, 10% edge prompts (few-shot). also run a 5k rerank probe set hourly.

sarah: auto-fallback behaviour? if a gate trips do we 100% rollback or throttle down first (e.g., 1% -> 0.5% -> 0)? what's smoothing window for signal detection?

elaine: proposed rollout config: 
```yaml
canary: sparq-v1
traffic: 0.02
monitor_window_mins: 60
gates:
  - name: conv_mrr
    threshold_pct: -0.7
    smoothing: 5m
  - name: hallucination_rate
    threshold_pp: 0.5
    smoothing: 10m
  - name: latency_p95
    threshold_ms: 30
    smoothing: 2m
fallback:
  mode: progressive_throttle
  steps: [0.01, 0.005, 0]
  hold_for: 10m
  on_trip: notify_pager
```
(uses progressive throttle instead of instant full rollback; can override if hallucination > 1.0pp)

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary job started at 6133337778, cluster pool: dedicated-canaries-1, nodes: 3xA10G, endpoint: https://canary.redwood.internal/sparq-v1

michael: if conv-MRR drops between 0.5% and 0.7% but latency is stable I propose we throttle to 1% then re-evaluate after 30m. avoid oscillation with a 15m cool-down.

priya: agreed. also add a lightweight semantic-similarity check on 2k random responses vs baseline (embedding cosine), threshold <= 0.02 mean delta. catches semantic drift.

elaine: good call — will add similarity check and the 15m cool-down. setting pager for hallucination > 0.8pp and MRR drop > 1.0% (emergency).

sarah: i'll wire alerts in console and add a small runbook: 
- gate trips -> infra throttles per steps -> signal owner (elaine) gets page -> if not acked in 5m -> full rollback to v2

deploy-bot: Canary health: minute-5: all probes green; minute-15: conv-MRR delta -0.12%, latency p95 +8ms, hallucination +0.02pp. continuing watch. :thumbsup:

elaine: thanks team. I'll post a short summary after 60m and tag folks. if anything spikes ping here.

michael: thanks — leaning on progressive_throttle for this one.

priya: saving the config to /ops/canaries/sparq-v1/config.yaml and will kick off rerank job in 10m.

elaine: noted, closing for now.
